As defined in the 1940 Act, the Company is deemed to be both an &#8220;affiliated person&#8221; and &#8220;control&#8221; a portfolio company if it owns more than </span><span style="font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">25</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% of the portfolio company&#8217;s outstanding voting securities or has the power to exercise control over the management or policies of such portfolio company (including through a management agreement).
